test_title: PYST 6: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:18 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Someone has drunk all the wine in the glass.

options.text: All the wine in the glass had being drunk.
All the wine in the glass has been drunk by someone.
All the wine in the glass had been drunk.
All the wine in the glass has drunk.

solution:
The correct answer is "**All the wine in the glass has been drunk by someone.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in active voice, where the subject (someone) performs the action (drinking the wine).
 
• To convert it into passive voice:
 
 
• **We need to make the object (all the wine in the glass) the subject of the sentence and use a form of the verb "to be" (has been) and the past participle of the main verb (drunk).**
 
• The preposition** "by" is used to indicate the doer of the action (someone) **in the passive voice sentence.
 
 
 
• The passive voice sentence emphasizes the action rather than the doer, which may be unknown or unimportant.
 
• The tense of the sentence remains the same (present perfect) in the passive voice.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: Incorrect. The sentence is in the wrong tense (past perfect) and missing the preposition "by" to indicate the doer in the passive voice.
 
• Option 3: Incorrect. The sentence is in the wrong tense (past perfect) and missing the preposition "by" to indicate the doer in the passive voice.
 
• Option 4: Incorrect. The sentence is in active voice and in the wrong tense (present perfect) for the subject (wine) to perform the action (drinking).
